articles.title: A Prehistoric Turducken? Fossil Shows Sea Monster Ate a Flying Reptile, Then Got Eaten!
articles.summary: Imagine a giant dolphin-lizard that swallowed a flying pterosaur, then got attacked by an even bigger crocodile-like beast! A fossil nicknamed 'BOB' found in Australia holds clues to this 100-million-year-old food chain.

articles.title: Secret Shopkeepers: The Illegal Cats of New York's Bodegas
articles.summary: Did you know the sleepy cat on the chip bags at your corner store is actually breaking the law? A new book, 'Bodega Cats of New York,' shares stories and photos of 60 furry, four-legged shop workers across the city.

articles.title: Get Ready to Slay Demons on the Go: Diablo 4 May Be Coming to Switch 2!
articles.summary: Rumors are swirling that the dark fantasy game Diablo 4 is headed to Nintendo Switch 2, maybe as soon as September. Rating boards have leaked listings, hinting at a $69.99 release.
